statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security and privacy lead and PCI DSS contact in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30, before each SAQ and after major change
Risk decision rules; High risks and exposed card data never accepted as they are
Annual control check and SAQs with evidence; outside review every second year
Annual policy review
One-page PCI scope note confirmed every year
Sanctions for helpers and any future employee
Written, time-limited exceptions
Card data only with providers that show current PCI DSS compliance
Provider list with data handled and PCI DSS responsibilities
Annual check of the processor AOC and website builder SOC 2 report
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
No customer data to any service whose terms allow reuse or training
Own accounts; separate cashier-level POS user; no shared credentials
MFA on every service that offers it
Unique 14-character passphrases; vendor defaults changed before first use
Quarterly review of users and add-ons
Device lock (laptop 5 minutes; tablet 2; phone 1)
Sealed emergency access codes
Change log for store and router settings; no code on checkout; monthly activity check
Terminal recorded and inspected daily; call-back before service; no camera on keypad
Guest Wi-Fi for customers; terminal on a separated network
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved places; customer exports deleted within 30 days
Card data never written down; security code never stored
No card numbers by email, text, or chat
Full-disk encryption on every device
Cross-cut shredding; device wipe or certified destruction
Business files in a plan with version history
Five-year retention of security records
Privacy notice and security statements match practice
Separate standard accounts for family and daily work
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Firewall on; no store admin on public Wi-Fi
No Restricted data in AI tools; owner reviews every AI output; P10 price rules
Annual training; terminal and scam basics for the family member
Reference check and policy acknowledgment for new helpers
Price and offer claims truthful and substantiated
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with the time noticed
Processor notified within 24 hours of suspected card compromise
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Keep evidence; no extortion payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Cash-only selling during outages; never write card numbers
Hurricane steps; no emergency price increases
